name: NGLE Triangle Voxelization
definition: A triangle rasterization algorithm that voxelizes a triangle into a sparse voxel DAG by classifying the triangle's bounding box thickness into 9 cases (1D, 2D, or 3D) and using plane/projection tests to determine which grid cells are intersected.
summary: NGLE Triangle Voxelization is a rasterization algorithm that converts triangle meshes into sparse voxel DAGs by classifying bounding box thickness into 1D, 2D, or 3D cases to optimize plane and projection tests.
